blocks.text: must va can't — dalilga asoslangan xulosa

Qizil kitobda **must** ni majburiyat ma'nosida o'rgangansiz: You must wear a helmet (→ qizil kitob, 31-dars). Bu darsda must ning ikkinchi, butunlay boshqa ma'nosi — **mantiqiy xulosa**. Biz biror dalilni ko'ramiz va undan «bu aniq shunday» degan xulosaga kelamiz: You've been travelling all day — you **must be** tired. O'zbekchada bunga «-sa kerak», «aniq ...», «...ekan-da» to'g'ri keladi: Kun bo'yi yo'lda bo'ldingiz — **charchagan bo'lsangiz kerak**. Teskarisi — **can't**: «...bo'lishi mumkin emas». Ikkalasi ham ishonchni bildiradi; noaniq taxmin uchun esa may / might / could ishlatiladi (→ 29-dars).

Hozirgi holat haqida xulosa: **must be** (sifat, joy, kim ekani), **must + holat fe'li** (know, have, live, like, mean) va jarayon uchun **must be + -ing**: They **must be waiting** for us — Bizni **kutayotgan bo'lishsa kerak**. Shakl bir xil, lekin ma'no kontekstdan aniq bo'ladi: majburiyatmi yoki xulosami? Quyidagi jadvalda farq ko'rinadi.

rows: That **must** be Mum calling. (oyim bo'lsa kerak)

items.text: Aziz started work at six this morning — he **must be** tired.
items.translation: Aziz bugun ertalab soat oltida ishga kirishgan — **charchagan bo'lsa kerak**.

items.text: Kate **must know** the answer; she's a doctor.
Listen! Someone **must be using** the lift.

blocks.text: Salbiy xulosa uchun **can't** ishlatiladi, **mustn't emas**: That **can't be** Aziz — he's in London — Bu Aziz bo'lishi mumkin emas, u Londonda. mustn't — faqat taqiq: You mustn't park here (→ 32-dars). Bu o'zbeklar uchun eng xavfli joy, chunki mantiqan «must ning inkori — mustn't» deb o'ylash oson. Yodda tuting: xulosada must ↔ **can't** juftlik.

items.text: That bag **can't be** yours — yours is black.
items.translation: Bu sumka seniki **bo'lishi mumkin emas** — seniki qora-ku.

items.text: James **can't be** at work — his car is outside his house.
items.translation: Jeyms ishda **bo'lishi mumkin emas** — mashinasi uyi oldida turibdi.

blocks.text: must have done / can't have done — o'tmish haqida xulosa

O'tmishdagi voqea haqida xulosa uchun modal fe'ldan keyin **have + V3**: **must have + V3** — «-gan bo'lsa kerak»; **can't have / couldn't have + V3** — «-gan bo'lishi mumkin emas». Jarayon uchun — **must have been + -ing**: Your eyes are red — you **must have been crying** — Ko'zlaring qizargan, yig'lagan bo'lsang kerak. O'tmishda can't have va couldn't have deyarli bir xil ishlatiladi.

items.text: Madina is smiling — she **must have passed** her driving test.
items.translation: Madina jilmayib turibdi — haydovchilik imtihonidan **o'tgan bo'lsa kerak**.

items.text: I **must have dropped** my glove on the bus.
He **can't have heard** you — he had his headphones on.
items.translation: U sizni **eshitgan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — quloqchin taqib olgan edi.

blocks.text: **couldn't** hozirgi zamonda ham «bo'lishi mumkin emas» ma'nosida uchraydi, ayniqsa kuchli hayrat bilan: That **couldn't** be true! Kelajak haqidagi taxmin uchun esa must emas, **will probably** / **will definitely** (→ 22-dars): «Ertaga yomg'ir yog'sa kerak» → It**'ll probably** rain tomorrow.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He mustn't be at home» → He **can't be** at home (mustn't — taqiq); «She must went» / «must gone» → she **must have gone**; «He must to be» → he **must be**; «U charchagan bo'lsa kerak» (hozirgi holat) → She **must be** tired — o'zbekchadagi «-gan» bu yerda hozirgi holatni bildiradi, shuning uchun must have been emas; «It must rain tomorrow» → It**'ll probably** rain tomorrow.

Xulosa formulasi: **dalil + must / can't**. Avval dalilni ayting (The lights are on...), keyin xulosani (...they must be in). O'tmish haqida — har doim **have + V3**: must have gone, can't have seen. Inkor xulosada mustn't ni butunlay unuting — faqat **can't**.

items: **must** + fe'l / be / be -ing — hozir haqida ishonchli xulosa: «-sa kerak».
**can't** + fe'l / be — hozir haqida «bo'lishi mumkin emas» (mustn't emas!).
**must have** + V3 — o'tmish haqida xulosa: «-gan bo'lsa kerak».
**can't have / couldn't have** + V3 — o'tmish haqida «-gan bo'lishi mumkin emas».
Xulosa doim **dalilga** tayanadi: ho'l ko'cha, yonib turgan chiroq, qizargan ko'z.
Kelajak haqidagi «-sa kerak» — **will probably**, must emas.

examples.title: Sure it's true: **must be**, **must** + verb
examples.description: Dalilga asoslangan ishonchli xulosa — hozirgi holat haqida. O'zbekcha «-sa kerak», «-ayotgan bo'lsa kerak».

sentences.text: You've been driving for ten hours — you **must be** exhausted.
sentences.translation: O'n soatdan beri mashina haydayapsan — juda **charchagan bo'lsang kerak**.

sentences.text: Madina has three jobs, so she **must be** very busy.
sentences.translation: Madinaning uchta ishi bor, demak u juda **band bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: The lights are on in their flat; they **must be** at home.
sentences.translation: Ularning kvartirasida chiroq yonib turibdi; **uyda bo'lishsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Jasur **must know** Tom well — they've been friends since school.
sentences.translation: Jasur Tomni yaxshi **bilsa kerak** — ular maktabdan beri do'st.

sentences.text: Kate keeps checking her phone; she **must be waiting** for an important message.
sentences.translation: Keyt telefonini tinmay tekshiryapti; muhim xabarni **kutayotgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: This restaurant is always full, so the food **must be** really good.
sentences.translation: Bu restoran doim to'la, demak taomi juda **mazali bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Oliver goes to the gym every day — he **must love** keeping fit.
sentences.translation: Oliver har kuni sport zaliga boradi — sog'lom bo'lishni juda **yaxshi ko'rsa kerak**.

sentences.text: There's a long queue outside the bank, so something **must be** wrong with the cash machines.
sentences.translation: Bank oldida uzun navbat bor, demak bankomatlarda biror **nosozlik bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Is that really your daughter? She **must be** at least eighteen now!
sentences.translation: Rostdan ham bu qizingizmi? U hozir kamida o'n sakkiz yoshda **bo'lsa kerak**!

sentences.text: Listen to that noise — the neighbours **must be having** a party again.
sentences.translation: Anavi shovqinni eshit — qo'shnilar yana **ziyofat qilayotgan bo'lsa kerak**.

examples.title: Sure it's not true: **can't be**
examples.description: Salbiy xulosa — can't (mustn't emas!): «bo'lishi mumkin emas».

sentences.text: That **can't be** Bekzod — he's on holiday in Turkey this week.
sentences.translation: Bu Bekzod **bo'lishi mumkin emas** — u bu hafta Turkiyada dam olyapti.

sentences.text: You've only just eaten! You **can't be** hungry already.
sentences.translation: Hozirgina ovqatlanding-ku! Yana **qorning ochgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: The bill **can't be** right — we only had two coffees.
sentences.translation: Hisob **to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin emas** — biz faqat ikkita qahva ichdik.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **can't be** serious about leaving her job — she loves it.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ishini tashlash haqida **jiddiy gapirayotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — u ishini yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Sarah **can't know** about the surprise party; nobody has told her.
sentences.translation: Sara kutilmagan ziyofat haqida **bilishi mumkin emas**; unga hech kim aytmagan.

sentences.text: It **can't be** midnight already! I feel like we've just arrived.
sentences.translation: Hali yarim tun **bo'lishi mumkin emas**! Endigina kelgandekmiz.

sentences.text: He **can't be** very rich if he still rents a tiny room.
sentences.translation: Agar hali ham kichkina xonani ijaraga olayotgan bo'lsa, u unchalik **boy bo'lishi mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: They **can't be** sleeping — I can hear music from their room.
sentences.translation: Ular **uxlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — xonasidan musiqa eshitilyapti.

sentences.text: The museum **can't be** closed on a Saturday afternoon, surely?
sentences.translation: Muzey shanba kuni tushdan keyin **yopiq bo'lishi mumkin emas**-ku, axir?

sentences.text: This **can't be** the right address; there's no house number 52 on this street.
sentences.translation: Bu to'g'ri manzil **bo'lishi mumkin emas**; bu ko'chada 52-uy yo'q.

examples.title: **must** or **can't**? Reading the clues
examples.description: Juft-juft: bir xil vaziyat, boshqa dalil — must (ha, aniq) yoki can't (yo'q, aniq).

sentences.text: Aziz isn't answering his phone. He **must be** in the meeting.
sentences.translation: Aziz telefonini ko'tarmayapti. **Yig'ilishda bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Aziz **can't be** in the meeting — it finished an hour ago.
sentences.translation: Aziz yig'ilishda **bo'lishi mumkin emas** — u bir soat oldin tugagan.

sentences.text: Emma's eyes are red. She **must be** upset about something.
sentences.translation: Emmaning ko'zlari qizarib ketgan. Nimadandir **xafa bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Emma **can't be** upset — she's just got the job she wanted!
sentences.translation: Emma **xafa bo'lishi mumkin emas** — u hozirgina xohlagan ishiga qabul qilindi!

sentences.text: This phone costs only fifty dollars? It **can't be** original.
sentences.translation: Bu telefon atigi ellik dollarmi? U **original bo'lishi mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: With that price, the watch **must be** genuine gold.
sentences.translation: Bu narxda soat **haqiqiy oltin bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: You **must be** joking! A flat in the centre for that money?
sentences.translation: **Hazillashayotgan bo'lsangiz kerak**! Shu pulga markazda kvartira-ya?

sentences.text: Surely you **can't be** cold — it's thirty degrees outside!
sentences.translation: **Sovqotayotgan bo'lishing mumkin emas**-ku — tashqarida o'ttiz daraja!

sentences.text: Their car isn't outside, so they **can't be** home yet.
sentences.translation: Mashinalari tashqarida yo'q, demak ular hali uyda **bo'lishi mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: Nilufar knows every street in Bukhara — she **must live** there.
sentences.translation: Nilufar Buxoroning har bir ko'chasini biladi — u o'sha yerda **yashasa kerak**.

examples.title: About the past: **must have done**
examples.description: O'tmishdagi voqea haqida ishonchli xulosa — must have + V3: «-gan bo'lsa kerak».

sentences.text: The streets are wet, so it **must have rained** during the night.
sentences.translation: Ko'chalar ho'l, demak kechasi yomg'ir **yoqqan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: I can't find my keys anywhere. I **must have left** them at the office.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni hech qayerdan topolmayapman. Ularni ofisda **qoldirgan bo'lsam kerak**.

sentences.text: Madina got the highest score — she **must have studied** really hard.
sentences.translation: Madina eng yuqori ball oldi — juda qattiq **o'qigan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: There's no milk in the fridge; somebody **must have drunk** it all.
sentences.translation: Muzlatgichda sut yo'q; kimdir hammasini **ichib qo'ygan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Tom looked terrible this morning. He **must have been** up all night.
sentences.translation: Tom bugun ertalab juda yomon ko'rinardi. Tun bo'yi **uxlamagan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: The front door was open when we came home. We **must have forgotten** to lock it.
sentences.translation: Uyga kelganimizda old eshik ochiq edi. Uni qulflashni **unutgan bo'lsak kerak**.

sentences.text: Kate didn't answer the doorbell; she **must have been** asleep.
sentences.translation: Keyt qo'ng'iroqqa javob bermadi; **uxlab yotgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: You **must have heard** the news about James — everybody's talking about it.
sentences.translation: Jeyms haqidagi xabarni **eshitgan bo'lsangiz kerak** — hamma shu haqida gapiryapti.

sentences.text: The ground is covered with leaves; the wind **must have been** very strong last night.
sentences.translation: Yer barglar bilan qoplangan; kecha kechasi shamol juda **kuchli bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Bekzod has a new car, so he **must have got** the promotion he wanted.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning yangi mashinasi bor, demak u xohlagan lavozimiga **ko'tarilgan bo'lsa kerak**.

examples.title: About the past: **can't have** / **couldn't have**
examples.description: O'tmish haqida salbiy xulosa — can't have / couldn't have + V3: «-gan bo'lishi mumkin emas».

sentences.text: Aziz **can't have seen** me — he walked straight past without saying hello.
sentences.translation: Aziz meni **ko'rgan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — salom bermasdan yonimdan o'tib ketdi.

sentences.text: You **can't have finished** the book already! It's six hundred pages.
sentences.translation: Kitobni allaqachon **o'qib bo'lgan bo'lishing mumkin emas**! Olti yuz bet-ku.

sentences.text: Sarah **couldn't have taken** the train — there were no trains because of the strike.
sentences.translation: Sara poyezdda **ketgan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — ish tashlash tufayli poyezdlar yurmadi.

sentences.text: The thief **can't have come** in through the window; it was locked from inside.
sentences.translation: O'g'ri derazadan **kirgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**; u ichkaridan yopilgan edi.

sentences.text: Jasur **can't have been** at the party — he was in hospital that night.
sentences.translation: Jasur ziyofatda **bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — o'sha kechasi kasalxonada edi.

sentences.text: They **couldn't have known** about the problem; nobody had told them.
sentences.translation: Ular muammo haqida **bilgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**; ularga hech kim aytmagan edi.

sentences.text: Emma **can't have forgotten** your birthday — she put it in her calendar.
sentences.translation: Emma tug'ilgan kuningni **unutgan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — u uni kalendariga yozib qo'ygan.

sentences.text: The exam **can't have been** that difficult if everyone passed.
sentences.translation: Hamma o'tgan bo'lsa, imtihon unchalik **qiyin bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: Oliver **couldn't have driven** home — his car was still at the garage.
sentences.translation: Oliver uyga mashinada **ketgan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — mashinasi hali ustaxonada edi.

sentences.text: Nilufar **can't have meant** what she said; she was just tired and upset.
sentences.translation: Nilufar aytgan gaplarini **jiddiy aytgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**; u shunchaki charchagan va xafa edi.

examples.title: **must be doing**, **must have been doing**
examples.description: Jarayon haqida xulosa: hozir — must / can't be + -ing, o'tmishda — must / can't have been + -ing.

sentences.text: Bekzod isn't at his desk; he **must be having** lunch.
sentences.translation: Bekzod stolida yo'q; **tushlik qilayotgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Why is Kate so quiet? She **must be thinking** about her exam results.
sentences.translation: Keyt nega bunchalik jim? Imtihon natijalari haqida **o'ylayotgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: The children are covered in mud — they **must have been playing** in the garden.
sentences.translation: Bolalar loyga belanib ketgan — bog'da **o'ynagan bo'lishsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Your eyes are red. You **must have been crying**.
sentences.translation: Ko'zlaring qizarib ketgan. **Yig'lagan bo'lsang kerak**.

sentences.text: The phone was engaged for an hour. Madina **must have been talking** to her mother.
sentences.translation: Telefon bir soat band bo'ldi. Madina onasi bilan **gaplashayotgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: He **can't be working** — it's Sunday and his office is closed.
sentences.translation: U **ishlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — bugun yakshanba, ofisi yopiq.

sentences.text: The driver **can't have been paying** attention; he went straight through a red light.
sentences.translation: Haydovchi yo'lga **e'tibor bergan bo'lishi mumkin emas**; u qizil chiroqdan to'g'ri o'tib ketdi.

sentences.text: Jasur smells of paint — he **must have been decorating** his flat.
sentences.translation: Jasurdan bo'yoq hidi kelyapti — kvartirasini **bo'yagan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: It's eleven at night, and the lights are still on. Sarah **must be working** late again.
sentences.translation: Kechki soat o'n bir, chiroqlar hali ham yonib turibdi. Sara yana kechgacha **ishlayotgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Tom **can't be enjoying** the party — look how bored he is!
sentences.translation: Tomga ziyofat **yoqayotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas** — qara, qanchalik zerikkan!

examples.title: Dialogue: who left the window open?
examples.description: Ikki kvartiradosh tartibsizlik sababini dalillar orqali aniqlaydi: must, can't, must have, can't have.

sentences.text: — Look at this mess! Someone **must have left** the window open.
sentences.translation: — Bu tartibsizlikni qara! Kimdir derazani ochiq **qoldirgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: — It **can't have been** me — I wasn't even home last night.
sentences.translation: — Men **bo'lishim mumkin emas** — kecha kechasi umuman uyda emasdim.

sentences.text: — Then it **must have been** Jasur. He always opens it when he cooks.
sentences.translation: — Unda Jasur **bo'lsa kerak**. U ovqat pishirganda doim derazani ochadi.

sentences.text: — He **can't have done** it either. He's been in Samarkand since Friday.
sentences.translation: — U ham buni **qilgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**. Jumadan beri Samarqandda.

sentences.text: — Really? But his shoes are by the door, so he **must be** back.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Lekin poyabzali eshik yonida turibdi, demak **qaytgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: — Oh, you're right. He **must have come** home late last night.
sentences.translation: — Ha, to'g'ri aytasan. Kecha kechasi kech **kelgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: — And he **must be sleeping** now, because his door is shut.
sentences.translation: — Hozir **uxlayotgan bo'lsa kerak**, chunki eshigi yopiq.

sentences.text: — He **can't be** asleep. I can hear him talking on the phone.
sentences.translation: — U **uxlayotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**. Telefonda gaplashayotgani eshitilyapti.

sentences.text: — Well, the wind **must have blown** the papers everywhere.
sentences.translation: — Har holda, qog'ozlarni shamol hamma yoqqa **uchirib yuborgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: — And that **must be** him coming out now. Let's ask him!
sentences.translation: — Anavi hozir chiqib kelayotgan **o'sha bo'lsa kerak**. Undan so'raylik!

examples.title: Mixed: clues, news and everyday detective work
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: hozir va o'tmish haqida ijobiy va salbiy xulosalar murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: The plane landed an hour ago, so Emma **must be** on her way here by now.
sentences.translation: Samolyot bir soat oldin qo'ndi, demak Emma hozir yo'lda **bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: These figures **can't be** correct — sales didn't double in one month.
sentences.translation: Bu raqamlar **to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin emas** — savdo bir oyda ikki baravar oshmagan.

sentences.text: The thieves **must have known** that the family was on holiday.
sentences.translation: O'g'rilar oila ta'tilda ekanini **bilgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Aziz **can't have received** my email; he always replies within an hour.
sentences.translation: Aziz xatimni **olgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**; u doim bir soat ichida javob beradi.

sentences.text: You **must be** Madina's brother — you look just like her!
sentences.translation: Siz Madinaning akasi **bo'lsangiz kerak** — xuddi unga o'xshaysiz!

sentences.text: Scientists believe the lake **must have been** much bigger thousands of years ago.
sentences.translation: Olimlarning fikricha, ko'l ming yillar oldin ancha **katta bo'lgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: That shop **can't be** making much money; there's never anyone inside.
sentences.translation: U do'kon ko'p **pul topayotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**; ichkarida hech qachon odam yo'q.

sentences.text: Kate looks very relaxed — her holiday in Edinburgh **must have done** her good.
sentences.translation: Keyt juda xotirjam ko'rinadi — Edinburgdagi ta'tili unga **foyda qilgan bo'lsa kerak**.

sentences.text: Surely the professor **can't have meant** that we should read all twenty books by Monday!
sentences.translation: Professor dushanbagacha yigirmata kitobning hammasini o'qishimiz kerak, deb **nazarda tutgan bo'lishi mumkin emas**!

sentences.text: There's a strong smell of smoke in the kitchen; Dad **must have burnt** the plov again.
sentences.translation: Oshxonada kuchli tutun hidi bor; dadam palovni yana **kuydirib qo'ygan bo'lsa kerak**.
